summary: Verified webmail external redirect fix and internal mailbox modal routes. All 4 external routes (/webmail, /mail, /roundcube, /rainloop) successfully perform window.location.replace to https://webmail.construpilot.pt (Roundcube LOGIN page loads, no more '404 Esta página não existe'). All 3 internal routes (/caixa-correio, /caixa-de-correio, /mailbox) still Navigate to /empresa?open=mailbox and open the 'Ligar a minha caixa de correio' modal after auth. /empresa continues rendering the 'Caixa de correio' button. Fix confirmed working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: ExternalRedirect intermediate page text is fine but redirect is so fast that the 'A redirecionar para o webmail…' message is rarely visible — acceptable UX, not an issue.

Note: unauthenticated access to /caixa-correio, /caixa-de-correio, /mailbox goes through /empresa which requires auth, so it lands on /login. After login, redirect to /empresa?open=mailbox is not preserved (user has to hit the URL again). Minor UX consideration, not part of this fix scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Webmail redirect fix fully validated. All 4 external routes land on webmail.construpilot.pt (Roundcube). Internal mailbox aliases still open the SMTP config modal on /empresa. No regressions.
